title: Microsoft Teams: organisation-wide meeting and call troubleshooting in the Teams admin center
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap, the supplied Microsoft notice and the cited documentation. Its paths, commands, role restrictions and licence conditions check out; an older Microsoft telemetry article gives a different retention period for users without Teams Premium, which should be acknowledged.

claims.claim: Completed-meeting quality is judged using intelligent media classifiers.

claims.claim: A highlighted telemetry value does not necessarily mean poor user experience.

claims.claim: An in-progress issue does not necessarily mean the user experienced degraded quality.
claims.quote: Since these values are general targets based on expected performance, the existence of an issue doesn't necessarily mean the user experienced degraded media quality.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/use-real-time-telemetry-to-troubleshoot-poor-meeting-quality#where-to-find-per-user-real-time-troubleshooting-telemetry, which states that 24-hour rule.
